parameterPolicy: Every scalar below is frozen a-priori from the Phase 5 diagnosis and is NOT tuned on p01-p05 aggregate results. Post-hoc calibrators, boundary operating thresholds and decoder duration/boundary priors are fitted per fold on the TRAINING performers only, never on the held-out fold and never on p00.

candidates.description: Unmodified full-v2. Reuses the frozen per-fold full-v2 checkpoints rather than retraining them: those checkpoints ARE the baseline this study must be measured against, and Phase 4 proved the cached responses reproduce the frozen segmental-v3 fold results byte-identically. Retraining under the same seed and config would spend ~4.5 CPU-hours to approximate a checkpoint already in hand.

No retraining. The frozen full-v2 checkpoints are reused and only the boundary channel is recalibrated post-hoc (isotonic, fitted on training performers) with the operating threshold selected on training performers. Directly tests the dominant measured cause: the operating point, not the head's quality.

Precision-oriented boundary objective: focal down-weighting of already-easy frames concentrates capacity on the ambiguous mid-range where the reliability diagram is worst, and the positive weighting is cut to attack the measured top-bin overconfidence (0.83 predicted vs 0.43 observed). Targets miscalibration at the top of the range.

Stronger coupling between the boundary head and chord-state switching, with a tighter boundary target window. Targets the measured finding that missed transitions carry near-true boundary probability (0.397 vs 0.424) but are overridden by a confident chord posterior (margin 0.332 vs 0.218).

calibrationPolicy.fittedOn: training performers of the fold only
calibrationPolicy.frameLabel: reference chord change within +/-0.25 s of the frame
calibrationPolicy.thresholdSelection: maximise peak-picked boundary F1 on training performers only
calibrationPolicy.rationale: The measured reliability curve is non-monotonic at the top (bins 0.3-0.6 underconfident, 0.7-0.9 overconfident), which a single temperature cannot correct in both directions. Isotonic is the least-assumption monotone fit and stays ranking-preserving, so it changes calibration without changing the head's discrimination.

decoders.description: Existing full-v2 decode (EMA smoothing + penalty-4 Viterbi). Does NOT consume the boundary head, so post-hoc boundary calibration is inert here by construction; reported to keep model effects separable from decoder effects.
Frozen segmental-v3 segmental-full decoder, unchanged. Consumes the boundary channel via boundary gating and flicker reconciliation, so it is the path on which calibration can act.

notes: Four candidates including the control, one training run per fold, chosen to test the causes actually measured in Phase 5 rather than to search architectures.

Interventions ruled out by measurement and deliberately NOT included: duration-aware negative supervision (false regions are as long as true ones, 2.52 s vs 2.60 s), boundary target realignment (timing is unbiased at +7.3 ms with 1045 early vs 1076 late), and any change to the chord architecture (discrimination is adequate; F1 0.77 is reachable from the existing head).
calibrated-boundary requires no training at all: it reuses the frozen full-v2 fold checkpoints and only transforms the boundary channel.
